title: HTML+CSS: add-contact button and modal dialog
description:
Add the static HTML and CSS needed for the Add Contact feature. No JS logic.

What: Add an 'Add Contact' button to the #contact-section header and a <dialog> modal form for entering contact details.

Algorithm:
1. In index.html, inside #contact-section, add a <button id='add-contact-btn'> labeled 'Add Contact' (or '+').
2. Add a <dialog id='add-contact-dialog'> element (after #app or at end of body) containing:
   - A <form method='dialog'> with fields:
     - tailscaleUserId (required text input, id='act-userid')
     - login (required text input, id='act-login')
     - mailboxHost (required text input, id='act-host', placeholder like 'alice-kith.tail-xxxxx.ts.net')
     - displayName (optional text input, id='act-name')
   - A submit button ('Add Contact')
   - A cancel button (form method dialog with value='cancel', or a close-dialog button)
   - Labels for each input (accessibility)
3. In style.css, add rules for:
   - #add-contact-btn: positioned in the #contact-section header area, small, unobtrusive
   - #add-contact-dialog: centered modal style; backdrop dimming; form layout (label+input pairs stacked)
   - Input fields: full width within form
   - Submit/cancel buttons row
   - Error text element inside modal for inline error feedback

Defensive programming rules:
- No JS in this bead — HTML/CSS only
- All form inputs must have id, name, and label for accessibility
- dialog element used (native browser modal — no custom event loop needed)
- All textContent rendering (no innerHTML patterns)

Tests:
- Visual: open index.html in browser, click Add Contact, dialog appears
- Accessibility: all inputs have <label for=...>
- No regression: existing layout unchanged (no id conflicts)
